items.title: Extract cmd-config to module
items.intent: Extract cmd_config_check (154 lines) to lazy-loaded module — isolated, only reads config
items.groomingNotes: Note: cmd_config_check is dispatched from a NESTED case block (config > check), not a top-level case. The lazy-load goes inside that nested block: 'check) _load_module cmd-config; cmd_config_check "$@" ;;'. The outer 'config)' case block with its shift logic stays in core. Also confirm cmd_config_check has no callers other than dispatch (grep confirms only line 6241). Pattern otherwise follows cmd-diagnose exactly.

items.title: Extract cmd-review to module
items.intent: Extract cmd_review (56 lines) to lazy-loaded module — calls run_agent which stays in core
items.groomingNotes: CRITICAL: cmd_review is called from TWO places, not just dispatch. Line 6229 (main dispatch) AND line 3808 (inside sprint loop, auto-review feature). Step 3 must update BOTH call sites: (1) dispatch: 'review) _load_module cmd-review; cmd_review "$@" ;;' AND (2) line ~3808 sprint loop: add '_load_module cmd-review' before the 'cmd_review || true' call. Failure to update the internal call will cause 'cmd_review: command not found' when --auto-review flag is used. _build_groom_context stays in core (called by sprint loop at line 3516 and by cmd_review itself via the module). Verify: run 'aishore run done --auto-review --dry-run' to exercise the internal call path.

items.groomingNotes: _compute_metrics_json (line 4211) is called only from cmd_metrics — extract to cmd-report.sh along with cmd_metrics (line 4257) and cmd_report (line 4318). Both dispatch entries need updating: 'metrics) _load_module cmd-report; cmd_metrics "$@" ;;' and 'report) _load_module cmd-report; cmd_report "$@" ;;'. Pattern follows cmd-diagnose.

items.groomingNotes: _status_output (line 4371) is called only from cmd_status (lines 4467, 4474) — safe to co-locate in cmd-status.sh. cmd_status (line 4459) is only called from dispatch (line 6232). items.title: Extract cmd-groom entry to module
items.intent: Extract only cmd_groom and print_groom_summary (46 lines) — groom helpers MUST stay in core (sprint loop calls them)
items.groomingNotes: WARNING: _build_groom_context() is defined at line 3923, between cmd_groom and print_groom_summary in the file. Do NOT extract it — it is called from (1) cmd_groom itself, (2) cmd_review (FEAT-057), and (3) the sprint loop auto-groom path at line 3516. It must stay in core. Only extract: cmd_groom (lines 3890-3920) and print_groom_summary (lines 3934-end). Extraction: move both functions to cmd-groom.sh, add dispatch update 'groom) _load_module cmd-groom; cmd_groom "$@" ;;'. print_groom_summary is only called from cmd_groom (confirmed via grep), so it safely moves.

items.title: Extract cmd-backlog-write to module

items.groomingNotes: cmd_backlog_add (line 5329), cmd_backlog_edit (line 5505), cmd_backlog_populate (line 5174) are all only called from cmd_backlog dispatch — no internal sprint-loop calls.
